cases.input: A run pins test revision, subject digest and qualified environment baseline.
cases.expect: The run is reproducible and each master remains distinct.

cases.input: A dependency outage in the pinned environment blocks the test.
cases.expect: The attempt is classified environment failure or blocked with evidence, not product defect.

cases.input: Identical definition, subject and environment produce failed, passed and passed attempts.
cases.expect: All attempts remain and the set is classified flaky without rewriting verdicts.

cases.input: A run with no environment evidence is declared reproducible and passed from exit code zero.
Toolchain and fixture changes are written into the same effective baseline.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected and a successor baseline is required.

cases.input: Changing the oracle advances a product defect to verified.
A pass on the original failing subject digest is used to verify the product fix.
